summary: smoke: single label stack (label 100, TTL 64) over inner IPv4/UDP -> 1 frame; tshark auto-parses MPLS (eth.type 0x8847)

inner L4 is UDP with flow default ports (src 12345, dst 80); tshark auto-parses MPLS and the inner IP/UDP
